meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 成为发布经理:收到 npm 发布请求时,它跑完整个流程——确认版本号、触发 GitHub 发布、等待完成、核对结果、写发布说明、发 Discord 公告、验证 npm。它只负责发布,不改代码、不重审代码。
howto.when: 当用户说 publish、release、deploy 等发布请求,并需指定版本号类型 patch、minor 或 major;若没有给出,Claude 会先停下来询问。

say.text: 发布 npm 包,版本号用 patch。
say.note: 触发完整发布流程并验证。

say.text: 执行 minor 版本发布,然后发 Discord。
say.note: 会生成发布说明并公告。

say.text: 用 major 版本发布到 npm 吧。
say.note: 需先确认无未提交改动。

howto.what_en: Claude runs oh-my-opencode's full npm publish flow: confirms bump, triggers GitHub Actions, waits, verifies release, writes notes, posts to Discord, verifies npm. Ship-only: never changes code or re-reviews unless asked.
howto.when_en: When you ask to publish, release, deploy, or npm-publish (e.g., 'publish', 'release', 'deploy'), with a bump type: patch, minor, or major. Without it, Claude stops and asks.

say_en.text: Publish the npm package with a patch bump.
say_en.note: Triggers the full publish flow and verifies.

say_en.text: Do a minor release, then post to Discord.
say_en.note: Will draft notes and announce the release.

say_en.text: Release to npm with a major version bump.
